description: Send one email to one recipient: transactional (receipt, code, alert) or marketing (category). It goes out as HTML in a branded template with a text part; give text, html or both. Uses 1 email of today's allowance. Many recipients at once: send_campaign.

brand.description: This email's look; the account's brand otherwise.

category.description: Default transactional. marketing: always has the unsubscribe link and skips role addresses and people who unsubscribed.

from.description: Name before the @ (e.g. hello). The domain is always email59.com. Optional.

list_id.description: Marketing only: your name for the audience.

preheader.description: Preview text shown after the subject.

reply_to.description: Optional. One address of your own (not at email59.com) where answers should go. Without it the email says replies are not received.

template.description: Layout. basic (default), code (one-time code, give code), notice (heading and one button), report (wide tables), letter (personal).

text.description: Plain-text body. Give text, html or both.

name: send_email
title: Send an email
